# SavingHarbor

> SavingHarbor is a coupon and deals platform with 1000 verified merchant stores across 10+ categories. Coupons are tested by hand before publishing.

## Key Sections
- [All Stores (A-Z)](https://www.savingharbor.com/stores): Full merchant directory
- [Categories](https://www.savingharbor.com/categories): Deals organized by category
- [Today's Coupons](https://www.savingharbor.com/coupons): Currently active codes and deals
- [How It Works](https://www.savingharbor.com/how-it-works): Coupon verification process
- [Blog](https://www.savingharbor.com/blogs): Shopping guides and savings tips
